source_feature.name: Black Cultural Center
source_feature.geometry_response: Queried with outSR=4326; transformed with project local approximation X=(lon+86.9137)*84810.60416539927, Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040.0, then centered on the footprint bounding-box midpoint.

footprint.metric_note: The source Shape__Area/Shape__Length are computed in native Web Mercator. Their larger map-plane values reflect Web Mercator scale inflation at Purdue's latitude; the outline transformed into the project local approximation is approximately 883 m2 and 144 m perimeter.
footprint.source_match: Official GIS BCC footprint FID 645; plan outline extruded directly into new structural shell. The separate Purdue campus GIS MapServer footprint (OBJECTID 279) was also queried; its outline is coincident within the same approximate project frame.
footprint.xy_transform_uncertainty: The project-defined degree-to-meter approximation is not a surveyed coordinate reference. Centering removes absolute placement from this detailed library; parent/master placement should still use existing campus marker.

library_placement.local_origin_is: midpoint of official footprint geographic/project-coordinate bounding box
library_placement.note: The master should place this detailed library with a Placement_black_cultural_center empty at the recommended XY. Existing massing center is offset by approximately 0.55 m horizontally from this footprint-envelope center.

vertical_evidence.source: GIS NUM_LEVELS=3 and Extrution=24; Purdue BCC page states second-floor lab and gives interior program
vertical_evidence.status: estimated; source height unit/definition not resolved and public photos do not provide measurement
vertical_evidence.uncertainty: No measured elevations or architectural plan dimensions; storey count field says 3 whereas public room description clearly identifies second floor, so 3 is treated as GIS floor/level coding and not literal story count.

limitations: The Google Maps pano at the site coordinate resolves to an interior lobby panorama, not an exterior street panorama; capture date is not shown in the available UI.
Photo references show changing temporary banners; the model avoids asserting a particular event campaign.
Facade bay widths, sill/head heights, and the partial lobby arrangement are interpreted from current images and public BCC descriptions rather than construction drawings.
Footprint outline verifies horizontal wall plan only; it does not verify wall heights, roof construction, or opening schedule.
